name: anatomy
summary: Claude Code skill that explains a technical idea by building it as a real working object: name an idea in one line and Claude invents a machine that does it, drawn as a live interactive isometric figure (SVG/WebGL) whose numbers come from the same model that moves its parts. Also runs in OpenCode and Codex.
ready_to_use: npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g -a claude-code  |  then: /anatomy explain how <idea> works, interactive
